checked_classes: ordering errors — the plan serializes baseline consolidation before admission work, admission before lifecycle/reconnect semantics, and delivery/payload publication after corrected source commits; no task depends on an artifact scheduled later.

missing dependencies — the plan covers the goal-required policy owner, restrictive policy composition, exact invocation identity, host admission, renderer/main-process boundary, replay/detach, cancellation/children, restart invalidation, and production integration evidence.

untestable or ambiguous acceptance criteria — the plan defines concrete gates A1/A2/B0 with policy matrices, identical-call cases, replay/restart/cancellation scenarios, source hashes, binary hashes, and expected effect/non-effect evidence.

scope smuggling — baseline, Liter, packaging, and worktree-preservation tasks are traceable to the analysis handoff and operator context as prerequisites for proving the approval architecture against the actual shipped Boss/UAR pair; unrelated historical recovery is explicitly deferred.

constraint violations — the plan does not instruct forbidden POSIX-only tools, does not edit generated constraint files, preserves unrelated WIP through scoped staging, keeps versions.toml operator-authored, and confines full-pack/reference-repo writes to the explicitly superseded integration scope described in the packet.
